name: @thetis/skills-all
description: Puts every skill's whole body in the system prompt, universal ones first then by id, until a byte budget is spent; nothing is a tool call away.

thetis.label: skill loader (all)
thetis.summary: Another way to give your assistant its skills: all of them, always.

budget.help: What skills may put in every prompt, in bytes. Every body is always in the prompt with this loader, universal ones first, then by id; the first that does not fit ends the fill, and the notes and the Skills panel name each one left out.
